key_difference: (B) adds a small destructor to RunFunctionTaskBase that cancels and finishes an unfinished promise when clear() deletes the runnable. (D) instead adds a new exported discard-handler registry to QThreadPoolPrivate, hooks it into QFutureInterfaceBase::setRunnable/reportFinished and ThreadEngineBase, and extends the fix to map/filter. This puts a pool-mutex hash insert and remove on every QtConcurrent::run task and depends on a ThreadEngineBarrier::releaseUnlessLast() that the diff never adds.
